verdict.rationale: There is no documented native 'export all data' feature in open formats (like a full CSV/Excel/QBO-file export) in the evidence pack, but the presence of REST APIs, SDKs, and an official MCP server with full CRUD access to 29 entity types and 11 financial reports (quickbooks-gh-3, quickbooks-gh-4, quickbooks-gh-5) suggests a technical path for an AI-native user to programmatically pull out their data via API. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data export tool, documented file formats (CSV/JSON/XML) for full account export, and any first-party 'migrate out' or backup-to-open-standard feature.
